projects.title: OMIRA
projects.subtitle: Personal AI Assistant for Windows
projects.desc: A Windows-based personal AI assistant that lets users interact with their computer using voice commands in English, Hindi, and Marathi. Features Gemini integration with OpenAI/Ollama fallback, system control, Gmail and WhatsApp automation, file summarization, and a system-tray desktop mode.
